title: slot-coord: no test coverage; add twister scenario enabling CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD
description: The dep fix (LICHEN_SCHNORR48 -> LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR) made LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD buildable for the first time since introduction — nothing ever compiled it, and rg finds no twister scenario or app enabling it (lichen/tests/, lichen/apps/: zero hits). The authz gate, NO_SIG/INVALID_SIG silent discard, 4.09 path, and the re-enabled build are all unverified. Fix: create lichen/tests/coap_slot_coord following the stub pattern of lichen/tests/coap_rangetest/src/main.c:55-75 (oscore mock knobs, local_admin stub, call_handler), covering: unauthenticated POST -> 4.01, protected valid claim -> 2.01, conflict -> 4.09, NO_SIG/INVALID_SIG -> silent (no response bytes), plus build-enable CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD=y + LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR=y. Note for implementers: has_signature is never settable (sibling bead) — test the silent-discard path as it exists today; sign-coverage tests land with the envelope fix.
